<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="kerapac-hybrid-magic-melee" class="pvme-source-title"><ins><nowiki>Kerapac — Hybrid Magic-Melee</nowiki></ins></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is an </nowiki><strong><nowiki>advanced guide</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#kerapac-hm-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This method aims to consistently hit sub-1:40 kill times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> required to have a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Nodon_dragonkin_slayer_assignment <nowiki>Nodon dragonkin</nowiki>]<nowiki> slayer assignment for this method to work, but it will improve your consistency with the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_helmet_stand <nowiki>Slayer helmet stand</nowiki>]<nowiki> boost </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="gear-relics-and-familiars"><ins><nowiki>Gear, Relics and Familiars</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=43ecd334-cee0-436f-af4b-5588ff47381f <nowiki>Magic-Melee Hybrid</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><ins><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At the bank, activate/apply:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Weapon_poison_%2B%2B%2B <nowiki>Weapon poison +++</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kwuarm_incense_sticks <nowiki>Kwuarm sticks</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1" alt="kwuarmsticks" title="kwuarmsticks" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Lantadyme_incense_sticks <nowiki>Lantadyme sticks</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489404899368.png?v=1" alt="lantasticks" title="lantasticks" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness <nowiki>Darkness</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Perks on both Magic and Melee gear:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Genocidal <nowiki>Genocidal</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if on slayer assignment</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ultimatums_4 <nowiki>Ultimatums 4</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478090603026710648.png?v=1" alt="ultimatums4" title="ultimatums4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Necklace:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Am-hej <nowiki>Am-hej</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1" alt="amhej" title="amhej" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the Melee portion (unless using an </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Amulet_of_zealots <nowiki>Amulet of zealots</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/926021352626982942.png?v=1" alt="zealots" title="zealots" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the Magic portion alongside </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Mystic_Might <nowiki>Mystic Might</nowiki>]<nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Overcharge <nowiki>Overcharge</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1344313901189431296.png?v=1" alt="overcharge" title="overcharge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F43ecd334-cee0-436f-af4b-5588ff47381f.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
